caption: The drawing features a single, rust-colored metal object centered against a plain, light beige background. The object has a flat, rounded base with a spout or opening on the left side and a hinged lid, forming an irregular, almost heart-like shape. Attached to the base is an elongated, curved handle that rises vertically before bending horizontally and finally angling upward into a twisted, angular hook. The surface of the object is textured, suggesting age or wear, and the drawing is rendered with fine attention to details of shape and shading. There is a signature reading "Alexander Brown" in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Wrought Iron Betty Lamp
